attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Allied Health Professionals

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved continuing competence programs (1 point per contact hour, up to all 24); publications (book up to 22 points, chapter or peer-reviewed article up to 2); teaching/presenting (4 points per academic credit taught, 1 per contact hour of CE taught; max 10 points, first-time presentations; repeats at half value); completed academic coursework (1 point per credit, max 6); other AOTA- or APTA-approved activities (max 6). Activities must relate to the science or contemporary clinical practice of OT.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by examination: requirement starts after the first renewal period following initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement under pains and penalty of perjury at renewal; the Board may randomly audit documentation for the two prior renewal periods.

topics.who: 2 points in ethics and/or Massachusetts laws and regulations governing practice (or a combination); counts toward the 24

rules.notes: 1 point = 1 contact hour for continuing competence programs (or equivalent as awarded by the provider). Activities must be completed in the 24 months before each renewal date; biennial renewal. The Board is to review the ethics/law mandate no sooner than four years after April 29, 2022.
